verdict.rationale: The README documents a one-line package-manager install (`npx skills add yylo-dev/yylo-skills`), including non-interactive all-skills installs for Claude Code, Codex and Pi, and single-skill installs via `--skill`. It also documents a first-party `yy skills install` command and a Claude plugin marketplace entry bundling all the skills. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that installed skills are active in the next agent session, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the install works as documented.
